os_version: Debian 13 (trixie), kernel 6.12.95+deb13-amd64, headless server — Xvfb 1280x800 (X11) + dbus-run-session, NO window manager

stack_detection.method: ldd shows libgtk-3.so.0 + libatk-bridge-2.0.so; after launch the app appears on the org.a11y AT-SPI bus with toolkit attribute 'gtk' — both checks precede any extraction
stack_detection.signature: libgtk-3.so.0 mapped; AT-SPI desktop lists 'mousepad' (toolkit gtk); a11y bus auto-activated via D-Bus service org.a11y.Bus

channel_setup: This machine is a headless server: everything runs under Xvfb + dbus-run-session, with Xvfb/xdotool/pyatspi extracted from .debs into a user prefix (no root; one 8-byte binary patch to relocate Xvfb's hardcoded xkbcomp path). The a11y bus needed NO manual setup — the first pyatspi client D-Bus-activated at-spi-bus-launcher + registryd, and GTK3's built-in atk-bridge registered the app. GTK_MODULES=gail:atk-bridge exported (belt-and-braces; GTK3 links atk-bridge directly). Typing via xdotool (real X keystrokes), clicks via xdotool (XTEST): the OS input path, not synthetic AT-SPI actions.

t1_read_text.detail: Typed 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog 0123456789' via xdotool; read back through the Text interface of the sole EditableText node: character-exact, arrives as real strings (no glyph decoding needed at this level).

t2_enumerate.detail: 154-node tree; 9 nodes SHOWING with extents — and the screenshot confirms the screen really shows exactly that (frame, tab list, scroll pane, text area). THE HONESTY RESULT OF THIS CELL: with no WM and no xfconf, Mousepad renders WITHOUT its menubar; AT-SPI reports the menubar present-in-tree but STATE_SHOWING=false and its items' extents as MININT ('no on-screen position'). The channel never claimed a control was clickable that wasn't rendered. Same story for window geometry: before an explicit resize the window really was 48x52 px, and AT-SPI's frame extents matched X's geometry byte-for-byte at every step (48x52 then 1000x700). Present-in-tree vs shown-on-screen is cleanly distinguished — exactly the distinction a router needs.

t3_live_value.detail: Unique string PX-7Q4K-LINUX-ATSPI typed then read back from the live buffer through the channel — current value, not a stale snapshot.

t4_living_screen.detail: Event-driven, not polled: object:text-changed:insert events carry position + inserted text. 3 s idle window = 0 events = 0 bytes (idle is genuinely free). 18 keystrokes → 18 events, ~21 B each (378 B total) vs 1365 tokens for one re-screenshot. The channel pushes deltas; pixels can only re-pull the world.

t5_blind_action.detail: End-to-end with REAL OS clicks, every coordinate from the channel: (1) right-click at the centre of the text node's extents (500,350) via xdotool → (2) the popup menu enters the channel: 12 menu items, each with real on-screen extents → (3) blind-click 'Select All' at its centre (672,569) → (4) effect verified IN the channel: Text.getSelection = [0,92] over a 92-char buffer, the whole document. No screenshot in the decision loop at any step.

t6_pictorial.detail: No pictorial region exists in this app (no image/canvas roles in the tree, none on screen — consistent). The Qt cells cover the pictorial/custom-paint question.

measurements.notes: The SHOWING view of a simple editor is 68 tokens vs 1365 for a screenshot (20x) — the synthetic-app-UI regime, as expected for a sparse native window. Full 154-node walk: 115 ms (per-node D-Bus round-trips; a production router would use the batched GetTree or cache). Event stream: 21 B per keystroke, 0 idle. The environmental result worth keeping: the AT-SPI bus auto-activates headlessly under plain dbus-run-session — the 'blocked: no a11y bus' status of the old sandbox cell was a sandbox artifact, not a Linux property.

runtime_verification.method: Root-window screenshot (GdkPixbuf) captured alongside each probe step; screenshots read back and compared to the emitted view; X window geometry cross-checked via xdotool getwindowgeometry.
runtime_verification.agreement: Full agreement including the degenerate cases: tiny 48x52 window (extents matched X exactly), hidden menubar (SHOWING=false + MININT extents, and the screenshot indeed shows no menubar), popup menu (items appear on screen and in the channel simultaneously, extents match the rendered popup).

permissions_required: None beyond a session bus (no root: all GUI packages extracted to a user prefix; a11y bus D-Bus-activated automatically)
